end.summary:
Practised speed = total distance ÷ total time using a cricket-ball example.
Calculated acceleration a = (v − u)/t, including negative acceleration, correctly twice without help.
Discussed that negative acceleration can represent slowing down and movement left on a number line.
Calculated average speed for a 60 km outward and 60 km return journey as 40 km/h.
Teach-back was not passed; Diya continued to request a visual animation or number-line demonstration.
end.parentNote: At home, use a simple number line or toy car: move 2 spaces left each second from 20 to show −2 m/s².
